draft: Inyandiko itaremezwa n’abanyamategeko. Ibice byanditseho “Bizemezwa” si ibya nyuma.

home.label: MediLink Rwanda
home.title: Ubuvuzi, bworoshye.
home.lead: Shaka ibigo by’ubuvuzi, urebe igihe biboneka kandi utegure urugendo rwawe — byose ahantu hamwe.
home.reassure: Reba serivisi z’ubuvuzi utabanje gufungura konti.
home.searchLead: Shakisha serivisi cyangwa ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kiri hafi yawe.
home.nearEmpty: Nta bigo byo kwerekana hano ubu
home.emergencyLead: Shaka ibigo by’ubuvuzi bifite serivisi z’ubutabazi bwihuse.

check.title: Reba igihe biboneka
check.body: Gereranya aho biri, igihe cyo gutegereza n’ubwishingizi.

join.title: Jya ku murongo cyangwa ufate igihe
join.body: Jya ku murongo w’uyu munsi cyangwa ufate igihe gihari.

receive.title: Ubuvuzi
receive.body: Gera ku kigo, wiyandikishe kandi ukurikire isura yawe.

home.accountLead: Fungura konti ucunge gahunda zawe, ukurikire umurongo wawe, ubone inyandiko z’isura yawe kandi umenye amakuru.
home.distanceHint: Kanda Hafi yanjye urebe intera ya buri kigo.

care.title: Shaka ubuvuzi
care.lead: Shakisha ukurikije ikigo, serivisi, ubuhanga cyangwa ikimenyetso.

facilities.title: Ibigo by’ubuvuzi
facilities.lead: Buri kigo cyemejwe kiri kuri MediLink.

facility.emergencyNote: Ibitaro byakira ubutabazi bwihuse. Hamagara {{number}} niba ubuzima buri mu kaga.
facility.insuranceLead: Ubwishingizi bwemewe kuri iki kigo. Amafaranga agaragara gusa kuri fagitire nyuma y’isura.
facility.referral: Abanyamuryango ba Mutuelle bakeneye urupapuro rwo kohereza kuri uru rwego.

bring.title: Ibyo kuzana
bring.documents: Ibisubizo cyangwa impapuro z’imiti byabanje, niba ubifite

facility.emergencyOpen: Serivisi y'ubutabazi ikora ku manywa na nijoro. Hamagara {{number}} niba ubuzima buri mu kaga.

doctors.title: Abaganga
doctors.lead: Shaka umuganga ukurikije izina, serivisi cyangwa ikigo.

doctor.privacy: Hagaragazwa gusa ibihe biboneka, ntihagaragazwa abafashe gahunda.

services.title: Menya serivisi z’ubuvuzi
services.lead: Serivisi zitangwa n’ibigo biri kuri MediLink.

service.aboutGeneric: Serivisi itangwa n’ibigo biri kuri MediLink. Baza ikigo uko isura igenda.

explain.general_consultation: Kubonana na muganga cyangwa umuforomo ku kibazo gishya cy’ubuzima cyangwa kwisuzumisha.
explain.paediatric_consultation: Ubuvuzi bw’impinja n’abana kugeza ku myaka 14.
explain.antenatal_care: Kwisuzumisha buri gihe utwite, ku mubyeyi no ku mwana.
explain.vaccination: Inkingo z’abana n’abakuru, hakurikijwe gahunda y’igihugu.
explain.eye_care: Gusuzuma amaso no kuvura indwara z’amaso.
explain.internal_medicine: Gukurikirana indwara zidakira ku bantu bakuru, nka diyabete cyangwa umuvuduko w’amaraso.
explain.laboratory_tests: Ibizamini by’amaraso, inkari n’ibindi bisabwa na muganga.

how.title: Uko MediLink ikora
how.lead: Kuva ku gushakisha kugeza ku isura yawe, intambwe ku yindi.

search.title: Shakisha ubuvuzi
search.body: Shakisha ukurikije serivisi, ikigo cyangwa uko wumva umeze.

select.title: Hitamo ikigo
select.body: Gereranya intera, igihe cyo gutegereza n’ubwishingizi.

join.title: Jya ku murongo cyangwa ufate igihe
join.body: Jya ku murongo w’uyu munsi cyangwa uhitemo igihe cya gahunda.

confirm.title: Bona icyemezo
confirm.body: Uhabwa nimero y’itike cyangwa kode ya gahunda.

follow.title: Kurikira isura yawe
follow.body: Reba umwanya wawe ku murongo n’igihe cyo kwinjira.

good.noAccount: Ushobora kureba ibigo, serivisi n’abaganga utagira konti.
good.reception: Abakira abantu bemeza ko wahageze mbere y’uko uhamagarwa.
good.noPhone: Nta telefoni igezweho? Ikigo kiguha itike yanditse, nimero yawe ikagaragara ku ikiganza cy’amashusho kandi ikavugwa mu ijwi.

emergency.title: Ukeneye ubutabazi bwihuse?
emergency.lead: Niba ubuzima buri mu kaga, ntutegereze gahunda. Saba ubufasha cyangwa ujye ku bitaro bikwegereye ubu.
emergency.nearestNote: Ahakira indembe haza mbere. Koresha Hafi yanjye kugira ngo utondeke ukurikije intera.

guidance.call: Banza uhamagare {{number}} niba umuntu adashobora kugenda neza.
guidance.nearest: Jya ku bitaro bikwegereye; ibigo nderabuzima bishobora kukohereza.
guidance.bring: Zana indangamuntu n’ikarita y’ubwishingizi niba bishoboka, ariko ntubitegereze.

emergency.loadFailed: Ntibyashobotse kubona ibitaro biri hafi. Hamagara {{number}} cyangwa wongere ugerageze.

finding.title: Gushaka ubuvuzi
finding.a1: Oya. Ushobora gushakisha ibigo, serivisi n’abaganga udafite konti.
finding.a2: Hashingiwe ku bategereje ubu n’igihe amasura aheruka yamaze kuri icyo kigo. Ni igereranya, rigaragara gusa iyo ikigo gitangaza amakuru y’ako kanya.

queue.title: Kujya ku murongo
queue.q1: Nshobora kujya ku murongo ndi mu rugo?
queue.a1: Yego, ku bigo bibyemera, mbere y’isaha ntarengwa y’umunsi. Genda igihe porogaramu ikubwiye.
queue.a2: Umwanya wawe ushobora gusubira inyuma gato. Bwira abakira abantu iyo uhageze.

booking.title: Gufata gahunda
booking.a1: Fungura ikigo, hitamo serivisi n’igihe kiboneka, hanyuma wemeze. Ugomba kwinjira kugira ngo ufate gahunda.
booking.a2: Yego, mu masura yawe, kugeza ku gihe ntarengwa cy’ikigo.

arrival.title: Kugera no kwiyandikisha
arrival.a1: Jya ku bakira abantu ufite nimero y’itike cyangwa kode ya gahunda. Bemeza ko wahageze.
arrival.q2: Nta telefoni igezweho mfite. Nshobora kwakirwa?
arrival.a2: Yego. Abakira abantu barakwandika bakaguha itike yanditse; ikiganza cy’amashusho igaragaza nimero yawe ikanayivuga.

insurance.title: Ubwishingizi
insurance.a1: Buri rupapuro rw’ikigo rugaragaza ubwishingizi cyemera kuri buri serivisi.
insurance.a2: Igiciro giterwa n’indwara, ibizamini n’imiti. Amafaranga agaragara kuri fagitire nyuma y’isura.

accounts.title: Konti z’abarwayi
accounts.a1: Yego. Ongeramo abagize umuryango mu mwirondoro wawe kandi ubafatire gahunda.
accounts.a2: Kanda “Wibagiwe ijambo ry’ibanga” ku rupapuro rwo kwinjira uhabwe umurongo kuri imeli.

documents.title: Inyandiko n’amakuru
documents.a1: Mu Nyandiko nyuma yo kwinjira. Buri imwe ifite kode na QR farumasi zishobora kugenzura.
documents.q2: Umuntu ashobora kugenzura ko inyandiko yanjye ari ukuri?
documents.a2: Yego, akoresheje kode iri ku nyandiko kuri “Genzura inyandiko”.

technical.title: Ubufasha bwa tekiniki
technical.a1: Fungura kuzigama interineti mu igenamiterere; impapuro zikora no ku murongo udakomeye nyuma yo gusura bwa mbere.
technical.a2: Emerera MediLink kohereza imenyesha muri mushakisha yawe kandi ufungure imenyesha mu igenamiterere.

about.title: Ibyerekeye MediLink
about.lead: MediLink ihuza abantu bo mu Rwanda n’ibigo by’ubuvuzi, kugira ngo ubuvuzi bworoshye kubona no gutegura.

what.title: MediLink ni iki
what.body: Urubuga rw’igihugu aho abarwayi babona ibigo, serivisi n’abaganga, bakareba igihe cyo gutegereza bakajya ku murongo cyangwa bagafata gahunda. Ibigo biyikoresha mu gucunga isura kuva ku kwakira kugeza kuri farumasi.

problem.title: Ikibazo ikemura
problem.body: Akenshi abantu bajya ku kigo batazi niba gifunguye, igihe bazategereza cyangwa niba cyemera ubwishingizi bwabo. Ibigo nabyo ntibibona neza abategereje.

how.title: Uko ihuza abarwayi n’ibigo
how.body: Ibigo bitangaza serivisi, amasaha n’umurongo w’ako kanya. Abarwayi bahitamo bafite amakuru y’ukuri bakagera ku gihe; abakira abantu bemeza buri wese uhageze.

access.title: Igera kuri buri wese
access.body: Gushakisha ntibisaba konti. MediLink ikora mu Kinyarwanda, Icyongereza n’Igifaransa, kuri telefoni nto no ku murongo udakomeye, kandi abadafite telefoni bakirirwa ku kigo bahabwa itike yanditse n’ihamagarwa mu ijwi.

privacy.title: Kurinda amakuru y’abarwayi
privacy.body: Amakuru y’ubuzima acungwa hakurikijwe itegeko ryo kurinda amakuru bwite (Itegeko 058/2021). Ibigo bibona gusa ibikenewe mu kukuvura, kandi buri gihe amakuru afunguwe birandikwa.

contact.title: Twandikire
contact.infoBody: Ku kibazo cy’isura, banza uvugane n’ikigo. Ku bijyanye na MediLink ubwayo, koresha iyi fomu.
contact.emergency: Ku butabazi bwihuse hamagara {{number}}. Iyi fomu ntikurikiranwa amasaha yose.
contact.name: Amazina
contact.subject: Impamvu
contact.failed: Ubutumwa ntibwashoboye koherezwa. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.

errors.name: Andika amazina yawe
errors.reach: Andika imeli cyangwa nimero ya telefoni
errors.subject: Andika impamvu

accessibility.title: Itangazo ku kugerwaho n’abantu bose
accessibility.lead: MediLink igomba gukoreshwa na buri wese.

standard.title: Igipimo dukurikiza
standard.body: Duharanira WCAG 2.2 urwego AA ku mpapuro zose rusange no muri porogaramu y’abarwayi.

features.title: Ibyo dukora
features.body: Indimi eshatu, utubuto tunini, guhindura ingano y’inyuguti, gukoresha clavier, aho uri hagaragara, ibisobanuro ku basoma n’amatwi, amabara atandukanye bihagije, nta makuru atangwa n’ibara gusa, no kugabanya imyitwarire iyo igikoresho cyawe kibisabye.

offline.title: Hanze y’urubuga
offline.body: Abadafite telefoni bakirirwa ku kigo bahabwa itike yanditse, ikiganza cy’amashusho ry’aho bategerereza n’ihamagarwa mu ijwi.

limits.title: Imbogamizi zizwi
limits.body: Ibisobanuro bimwe biracyasuzumwa n’abavuga ururimi kavukire. Ikarita isaba imbeba cyangwa gukoraho; urutonde ruri iruhande rwayo rutanga amakuru amwe. [To confirm]

feedback.title: Tubwire
feedback.body: Niba hari ikigoye gukoresha, twandikire ukoresheje urupapuro rwo kutwandikira tuzagusubiza.

home2.tag: Igihe cyo gutegereza kigaragara ako kanya mu bigo byemejwe
home2.title: Bona ubuvuzi bukwiye, udategereje igihe kirekire.
home2.lead: Gereranya amavuriro n'ibitaro biri hafi, urebe ibikora n'uko umurongo ureshya, hanyuma winjire ku murongo cyangwa ufate gahunda.
home2.howTitle: Kuva gushakisha kugeza kwakirwa, mu ntambwe eshatu
home2.howLead: Nta konti ikenewe ngo urebe; konti ikenewe ngo winjire ku murongo cyangwa ufate gahunda.

search.title: Shakisha kandi ugereranye
search.body: Reba ibikora, igihe cyo gutegereza, intera n'ubwishingizi bwakirwa.

join.title: Injira ku murongo cyangwa ufate gahunda
join.body: Injira ku murongo w'uyu munsi uri kuri telefone, cyangwa ufate isaha.

arrive.title: Ngwino igihe cyawe kigeze
arrive.body: Kurikira umwanya wawe ako kanya, uze igihe wegereje imbere.

home2.facilitiesLead: Abarwayi babona igihe cyo gutegereza mbere yo kuza. Wowe ubona umurongo, urujya n'uruza n'umunsi wose ku kibaho kimwe.

photos.main: Umukozi w'ubuzima wambaye umwambaro w'icyatsi yereka umugore uko akoresha porogaramu kuri telefone ye, ku kwakira kw'ikigo nderabuzima.
photos.entrance: Umuryango w'ikigo nderabuzima utwikiriye, abarwayi bategereje bicaye ku ntebe.
photos.hillside: Ikigo nderabuzima cyubakishije amatafari gifite igisenge cy'icyatsi, hagati y'insina n'imisozi itoshye.
